description.p: Nitor is a small, focused monitor control panel for Linux. It talks to your display over DDC/CI and exposes every standard feature the monitor reports in its capabilities string: brightness, contrast, colour preset, RGB gain, gamma, saturation, scaling, input source, speaker volume, OSD language and a read-only information section.

The interface is built with GTK 4 and libadwaita, follows the system light or dark style, reads values from a cache so it opens instantly, and writes changes with a short debounce so dragging a slider does not flood the DDC bus.

ul.li: Automatic feature discovery from the monitor capabilities string
Brightness, contrast, colour, gamma, saturation, scaling and volume
Input source, power mode and OSD language
Read-only information: frequencies, panel type, usage time, firmware
Single instance, cached values and mode-change protection
